pairs.why: both build skin tone from two raters; write-up omits the averaging step
one dichotomises skin tone at 0.25, the other at 0.125
both report the dark-skin effect as an average marginal effect on the risk-difference scale
both are the primary logistic regression; list_1 defers the covariate list
list_1 excludes height/weight from the model; list_2 keeps them, dropping only in sensitivity
both drop dyads missing skin tone to form the analytic sample
both establish the player-referee dyad dataset as the analysis universe
